title: IoT Gate Pipeline
tagline: RFID + multi-camera ingestion for farm data collection
intro: A cross-platform IoT pipeline that ingests RFID and multi-camera streams to build datasets for AI vision.
summary: Integrated EU RFID readers with RTSP and USB cameras on Linux/Windows. Multithreaded ingestion streams structured data to Firebase and assets to Cloud Storage for training/monitoring workloads.
features: Structured persistence to Firebase and GCS

sections.title: Description
sections.body: An IoT data pipeline for farm environments integrating RFID readers and multi-camera inputs to feed AI models.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Automate identification and streamline data collection across diverse hardware setups.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Engineered the pipeline, implemented RFID integration, added multi-camera support, and built multithreaded concurrency.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Reduced manual data collection overhead and established a consistent backbone for AI training/testing.
